candidates.official_guidance: Employees must confirm their residency with local authorities after establishing their home.
candidates.actual_reality: Employees often forget to confirm their residency, leading to issues with services and benefits.

candidates.title: School Registration Deadlines
candidates.official_guidance: School applications should be submitted before the start of the school year.
candidates.actual_reality: Some schools may have additional requirements or earlier deadlines that are not widely advertised.
candidates.action_required: Research local schools and their specific application deadlines. Family must apply as soon as possible upon arrival.
